title: Ghar May Allah ke
body:
ghar mein allah ke khud uska wali zakhmi hai
jis mein tauheed hai maqbeer wo jali zakhmi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay khuda bach to gayi teri khudaai lekin
ek sajde mein mera maula ali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zarbe taaza to abhi aayi hai us ke sar par
jis ke seene mein jo dil hai azali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kisi aur ka sar ay mere mabood nahi
ye koi aur nahi hai ye ali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah baandhi gayi uske galay mein rassi
jis mein khayncha gaya usko wo gali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam o girya se faariq nahi koi maujood
aalam e sarmadi o lam yazali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayyat e silsila e zakhm hai jaari ye naved
har wali ibne wali ibne wali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
author: Ahmed Naved
